title: Cycle Relations and Global Gluing in Multi-Node Conifold Degenerations
summary: We study projective one-parameter conifold degenerations whose central fiber has finitely many ordinary double points. Existing finite-node theory isolates one rank-one local sector per node on the perverse-sheaf, mixed-Hodge-module, and categorical sides, but does not determine which global extension classes are actually realized by geometry. We show that when the nodes are linked by common cycle geometry or homological relations, the corrected extension is not free nodewise data, but is forced into a smaller relation-controlled subspace.
